entities.name: Sidelink Communication Reception
entities.description: Procedure for a UE configured to receive NR sidelink communication to monitor sidelink control information and corresponding data using configured resource pools.

entities.name: Conditions for NR sidelink communication operation met
entities.description: Precondition defined in clause 5.8.2 that must be satisfied for sidelink communication operation.

entities.name: Frequency included in sl-FreqInfoToAddModList or sl-FreqInfoList
entities.description: Condition that the frequency used for NR sidelink communication is included in sl-FreqInfoToAddModList in RRCReconfiguration or sl-FreqInfoList in SIB12.

entities.name: UE configured with sl-RxPool in RRCReconfiguration with reconfigurationWithSync
entities.description: Condition that the UE is configured with sl-RxPool included in RRCReconfiguration message with reconfigurationWithSync (handover).

entities.name: Cell provides SIB12
entities.description: Condition that the cell chosen for NR sidelink communication provides SIB12.

entities.name: sl-RxPool
entities.description: Information element indicating the pool of resources for sidelink reception.

entities.name: RRCReconfiguration
entities.description: RRC message that may contain sl-FreqInfoToAddModList and sl-RxPool configurations.

entities.name: SIB12
entities.description: System Information Block 12 containing sidelink communication configuration including sl-FreqInfoList and sl-RxPool.

entities.name: SL-PreconfigurationNR
entities.description: Preconfiguration for sidelink communication defined in clause 9.3, containing preconfigured sl-RxPool.

entities.name: Monitor sidelink control information and data
entities.description: Action where UE configures lower layers to monitor sidelink control information and corresponding data using specified resource pools.

relations.description: Sidelink communication reception procedure requires that conditions for NR sidelink communication operation are met.
Sidelink communication reception procedure requires that frequency is included in configured lists.
When UE is configured with sl-RxPool in RRCReconfiguration with reconfigurationWithSync, it establishes monitoring using that pool.
When cell provides SIB12, it establishes monitoring using sl-RxPool in SIB12.
Preconfiguration establishes monitoring using preconfigured sl-RxPool in SL-PreconfigurationNR.
RRCReconfiguration message may contain sl-RxPool information element.
